headline: Caprity Berry Picker
title: Caprity | Berries And Hunger Help | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want free berries? Try Caprity. Its partner skill, Berry Picker, sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when it is assigned to a Ranch. In your party, the same skill also feeds the Pal with the lowest hunger every five minutes, and it does not stack. At base it works Planting at level two and Farming at level one. How do you use Caprity? Comment below!
description: Caprity in Palworld 1.0: Berry Picker drops Red Berries at the Ranch and restores hunger in your party, plus Planting two and Farming one.
